The original eau de parfum Baccarat Rouge 540, the signature fragrance of Baccarat Crystal, is now available in a new form: as an extrait de parfum.
An intense red colour!
Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum enhances the power and radiance of the three main fragrance components that make up the eau de parfum, without distorting the original inspiration.
